name: Lupus
overview: Lupus is an autoimmune disease, which means the body's defense system mistakenly attacks its own healthy tissue. It can affect the skin, joints, kidneys, heart, and more, and it tends to flare up and then quiet down. Most people with lupus are women, and it often starts between ages 15 and 44. There's no cure yet, but modern medicines control the disease so well that most people with lupus live full, active lives.
symptoms: Extreme tiredness that rest doesn't fix
A butterfly-shaped rash across the cheeks and nose

drugs.name: Hydroxychloroquine (Plaquenil)
drugs.note: The backbone of lupus care; gently calms the immune system.

drugs.name: Prednisone
drugs.note: Quickly settles flares while other medicines take effect.

drugs.name: Mycophenolate (CellCept)
drugs.note: Protects organs like the kidneys in more serious lupus.

drugs.name: Belimumab (Benlysta)
drugs.note: Targets the immune cells that drive lupus when standard treatment isn't enough.

redFlags: Chest pain, trouble breathing, new confusion, or a seizure during a lupus flare is an emergency — call 911.

name: Fibromyalgia
overview: Fibromyalgia causes widespread pain, deep fatigue, and trouble sleeping or concentrating (often called "fibro fog"). It isn't caused by joint damage — instead, the nervous system seems to turn up the volume on pain signals. It's real, it's common, and it affects women more often than men. While there's no cure, a mix of regular gentle exercise, good sleep habits, stress management, and certain medicines helps most people feel meaningfully better.
symptoms: Deep fatigue, even after a full night's sleep
Heightened sensitivity to touch, noise, or light

drugs.name: Regular low-impact exercise
drugs.note: Walking, swimming, or yoga is one of the most proven treatments.

drugs.name: Duloxetine (Cymbalta)
drugs.note: Eases pain while lifting mood and energy.

drugs.name: Amitriptyline
drugs.note: An older, low-cost option that can improve sleep and pain.

redFlags: Fibromyalgia doesn't cause hot swollen joints, high fever, or sudden weakness — those signs point to something else, so seek same-day care.

name: Psoriatic Arthritis
overview: Psoriatic arthritis is a form of arthritis that affects some people who have psoriasis, the skin condition that causes scaly, itchy patches. It can make joints stiff, swollen, and painful, and may cause sausage-like swelling of a finger or toe. Catching it early matters, because untreated inflammation can damage joints over time. The good news: today's medicines can calm the inflammation, protect the joints, and often clear the skin too.
symptoms: Sausage-like swelling of a finger or toe
Morning stiffness that lasts a while

drugs.name: Ibuprofen / Naproxen
drugs.note: Eases mild joint pain and stiffness.

drugs.name: Methotrexate
drugs.note: A weekly medicine that slows joint inflammation.

drugs.name: Adalimumab (Humira)
drugs.note: Calms inflammation in both the joints and the skin.

drugs.name: Apremilast (Otezla)
drugs.note: A pill option often used for milder disease.

drugs.name: Secukinumab (Cosentyx)
drugs.note: Another biologic that treats joints and skin together.

redFlags: A single joint that is suddenly hot, very swollen, and paired with fever could be infected — seek same-day or emergency care.

name: Ankylosing Spondylitis
overview: Ankylosing spondylitis is a type of arthritis that mainly affects the spine, causing long-term inflammation in the back and hips. It usually starts in early adulthood with back pain and stiffness that's worse in the morning and better with movement — the opposite of a typical strained back. Over time it can cause bones in the spine to fuse, so early treatment and regular exercise matter. Today's medicines can ease pain and slow the disease itself.
symptoms: Low-back pain and stiffness, worst in the morning
Pain that improves with movement, not rest
Stiffness that wakes you late in the night
A gradually stooped posture over time

drugs.name: Naproxen / Ibuprofen
drugs.note: The first choice for easing pain and stiffness.

drugs.name: Physical therapy & daily stretching
drugs.note: Keeps the spine flexible and posture strong.

drugs.name: Adalimumab (Humira)
drugs.note: Used when NSAIDs aren't enough; slows the disease itself.

drugs.name: Secukinumab (Cosentyx)
drugs.note: An alternative biologic when TNF blockers aren't a fit.

redFlags: Severe back pain after even a minor fall, or new numbness with loss of bladder or bowel control, needs emergency care — go to the ER.
